with a prayer that the cognizance order dated 07.04.2025 as well as the Charge Sheet dated 26.09.2024 and the entire proceedings of the Criminal Case No. 2198 of 2025 (Case Crime No. 193 of 2024) titled as "State vs. Shailendra Kumar" under Sections 323, 504, 506, 498A of IPC along with 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, at Police Station Kotwali Dehradun, District Dehradun,
pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun may be quashed.

Today, the Applicant-Shailendra Kumar, S/o Shri Kamesh Chandra Gupta, is present and has been duly identified by Mr. Abhishek Verma, Advocate.

Respondent No. 2-Vandna Sharma, D/o Vidya Sagar Sharma, is also present and has been identified by Ms. Aishwarya Thapliyal, Advocate,
holding brief of Mr. Arjun Arora, Advocate for respondent no.2.

The motion is being considered between the husband and wife in the learned lower court.
